# WhatsAppMSG

> Enterprise WhatsApp Business API, Messaging, Automation & AI Platform

WhatsAppMSG is an enterprise WhatsApp Business Cloud API platform that enables businesses to connect WhatsApp numbers, automate customer conversations, run high-volume marketing campaigns, manage multi-agent shared inboxes, integrate developer APIs, and deploy domain-trained AI WhatsApp customer support agents.

## Core Capabilities

- **Direct Meta Cloud API Integration**: Direct Meta Cloud API connectivity with high-volume (100k+ messages/day) throughput, 0% middleman markups, and green tick badge assistance.
- **Autonomous AI WhatsApp Agents**: Domain-trained LLM agents powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) on custom PDFs, documents, catalogs, and websites to automate 80%+ of Tier-1 support tickets 24/7.
- **Multi-Agent Shared Inbox**: Single verified WhatsApp number shared across multiple agents with collision detection, round-robin routing, and internal private notes.
- **Visual Workflow Automation**: Drag-and-drop conversational journey builder for abandoned cart recovery, lead qualification, order tracking, and drip campaigns.
- **Broadcast Campaigns**: Scheduled high-throughput marketing broadcasts with rich CTA buttons, list messages, and real-time delivery/read analytics.
- **Developer API & Webhooks**: REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and granular API keys for seamless integration with CRMs, Shopify, WooCommerce, and backend systems.

## Developer Quickstart

Send a WhatsApp template message via WhatsAppMSG API:

```javascript
import { WhatsAppMsgClient } from '@whatsappmsg/sdk';

const client = new WhatsAppMsgClient({
  apiKey: process.env.WHATSAPPMSG_API_KEY,
  phoneNumberId: 'phone_982183921'
});

const result = await client.messages.sendTemplate({
  to: '+15551234567',
  templateName: 'order_confirmation_v2',
  language: 'en_US',
  components: [
    { type: 'header', parameters: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Order #8921' }] },
    { type: 'body', parameters: [{ type: 'text', text: '$149.00' }] }
  ]
});

console.log('Message delivered via Meta Cloud API:', result.messageId);
```
